name: Unique Organics Limited
about: Unique Organics Limited manufactures and trades feed, food, and spices products in India and internationally. The company offers barley, compound feed, maize/pellets, rice, sesame seeds, and soybean meal and seeds; feed ingredients, including DDGS, guar meal, rapeseed meal, and mustard oil cake; spices and herbs, such as black cumin seeds, dehydrated green and black pepper, fennel, fenugreek, herbs, and turmeric, as well as other spices; oil seeds comprising black and yellow mustard seeds, peanuts, and sunflower seeds; and feed, which includes bypass protein, castor seed meal, cattle, camel, goat feed, and toxin binder. It also provides compound cattle feed; mineral mixtures under the ROHINI brand name; and madhu amrit and liquid calcium. In addition, it offers cattle feed contract manufacturing services. Unique Organics Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Jaipur, India.
